description: Inspect bounded recent gh-aw logs and available rich evidence without a control-plane installation. Missing evidence remains unknown; native maintenance requires trusted terminal approval.

upgrade-repository.description: Request an Agentic Workflows compiler upgrade for each selected repository. Each native command requires terminal approval and publishes a pull request; unknown compiler versions are not evidence that an upgrade is needed.

arguments.label: Create pull request
arguments.description: Required for native maintenance; commands without pull-request publication are rejected.

upgrade-target-repository.description: Request a compiler upgrade pull request for this repository after trusted terminal approval.

arguments.label: Create pull request
arguments.description: Required for native maintenance; commands without pull-request publication are rejected.

overview.intent: Inspect the bounded recent evidence actually retained for selected repositories.
overview.subject: Retained workflow run observations, not fleet health or verified operational value.
overview.objective: Choose a run for investigation without inferring the health of unobserved workflows.
overview.acceptance: Count only retained run identities. Collection is bounded and partial; missing runs, artifacts, outcomes and workflow health remain unknown. Runtime success and grader observations do not establish verified delivery or value.
overview.description: Bounded recent evidence only. Collection is partial; unobserved workflow health, verified delivery and operational value remain unknown. Inspect Runs and Graders for the underlying observations.

views.title: Retained recent runs — partial collection
views.description: Only run identities present in this bounded collection are counted. This is not a count of healthy workflows, a complete run history, or verified delivery.

maintenance/maintenance-repositories.description: Inspect known compiler versions or explicitly request an approved upgrade pull request for selected repositories. Unknown versions never become an upgrade recommendation.

imported-queries.name: immediate-outcomes
imported-queries.subject: Retained normalized safe outputs and their observed workflow identities.
imported-queries.objective: Preserve rich report drilldowns without a campaign inventory join.
imported-queries.acceptance: Use the production outcomes query with intrinsic workflow identities; absent campaign and issue disposition evidence remains unknown.

imported-queries.name: immediate-work-item-run-times
imported-queries.subject: Latest observed start per workflow.
imported-queries.objective: Bound the lifecycle view to the newest retained run.
imported-queries.acceptance: Reuse production grouping over normalized observed run timestamps.

imported-queries.name: immediate-work-item-run-identities
imported-queries.subject: Latest observed run identity per workflow and start time.
imported-queries.acceptance: Reuse production run-number ordering within the selected workflow identity.

imported-queries.name: immediate-work-item-run-attempts
imported-queries.subject: Latest retained attempt for the latest observed run.
imported-queries.acceptance: Reuse production attempt ordering; absent attempts are not invented.

imported-queries.name: immediate-work-item-latest-runs
imported-queries.subject: Latest retained run and matching attempt for each workflow.
imported-queries.acceptance: Reuse production identity and attempt joins without campaign records.

imported-queries.name: immediate-work-item-run-outcomes
imported-queries.subject: Observed pending safe outputs for a matching run attempt.
imported-queries.objective: Retain review signals only when issue state is actually observed.
imported-queries.acceptance: Reuse production outcome aggregation; absent issue state does not become an open output.

imported-queries.name: immediate-work-items
imported-queries.subject: Observed workflow lifecycle within selected repositories.
imported-queries.objective: Preserve failure and review drilldowns without campaign or hosted admission requirements.
imported-queries.acceptance: Reuse production lifecycle classification over intrinsic workflow identities and observed runs; missing admission, campaign and output state remain unknown.

queries.name: immediate-retained-run-count
queries.subject: Distinct run identities actually retained in the bounded immediate collection.
queries.objective: Summarize collected evidence without evaluating unobserved workflows or claiming verified outcomes.
queries.acceptance: Count canonical repository-scoped run IDs only. Preserve partial collection metadata; this count is not total history, fleet health, verified delivery or operational value.

queries.name: maintenance-repository-versions
queries.subject: Known compiler evidence for observed remote workflow identities.
queries.objective: Keep selected repositories visible even when remote Actions paths are lock YAML rather than local Markdown sources.
queries.acceptance: Group observed workflow identities without requiring local source files. Missing compiler versions remain explicitly unavailable, not an upgrade recommendation.

queries.name: immediate-work-item-run-observations
queries.subject: Canonical observed run identities with their intrinsic workflow parents.
queries.objective: Supply the production latest-run lifecycle contract from public intrinsic logical sources.
queries.acceptance: Read runs and workflow-identities through the production query boundary; rename only observed fields, never synthesize admission, provenance or output state.
